warning.message: Friendly reminder: Merchants planning to join Open Commerce do not need to pay any recruitment service provider or third party during onboarding. Please be aware.
warning.description: Currently, only merchants in the digital appliances/office, pet supplies, maternal and infant toys, apparel and footwear, sports and outdoor, auto parts and motorcycles, and healthcare categories may apply for self-onboarding. Do not submit applications for other invitation-only categories. Onboarding reviews are expected to be completed within 7 business days. Thank you for your support.
